describes: Cement render over a brick chimney stack: a mid grey, streaked darker by soot and rain.

notes.water: Its water profile as the town's (Shaders/Water.hlsl, Overstory.World.WaterPack): how much it darkens wet, how glossy its wet film, how long it holds water, how readily run-off stains it. Cement render soaks and stays dark. Judged by look.
